title: PQVeinMiner
description: A lightweight and optimized vein mining plugin for Paper/Spigot servers. Mine connected ores naturally while sneaking, with balanced limits and vanilla-friendly gameplay.
body:
# PQVeinMiner

PQVeinMiner is a lightweight plugin for Paper/Spigot servers that adds natural vein mining while the player is sneaking.

## Features

- When breaking an ore while sneaking, the plugin automatically mines connected ores of the same type.
- Limit of up to 32 blocks per action to prevent exploitation.
- Supports common ores: coal, iron, gold, diamond, emerald, redstone, lapis lazuli, and copper.
- Does not add items or complex mechanics; works naturally with the tool in hand.

## Usage

1. Sneak (`SHIFT`).
2. Break an ore block.
3. The plugin will automatically vein mine connected ores of the same type.

## Compatibility

- `[1.20.x - 1.21.x]`
- `Paper, Bukkit, Spigot`

Ideal for servers that want to improve the mining experience without heavily changing the vanilla gameplay.
